newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-Gidusa raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Gidusa raised to buy.

text.p: Caspian Research raised its rating on Mexican paper firm Grupo Industrial Durango SA (Gidusa) to buy from market performer, the brokerage said in a statement on Friday.
Analysts Jorge Beristain and Sebastien Chatel said the stock has underperformed the stock market's leading IPC index by 30 percent since early September, 1996.
They said the company is expected to post strong earnings growth during the next three years and that its large cash flow should allow it to reduce its debt position.
"This, in conjunction with Gidusa's large discounts to its U.S. peers and a possibly recovery in international linerboard prices in 2H97 leads us to upgrade our rating," they wrote in the report.
Gidusa shares were unchanged at 39.70 pesos per share on the Mexican market.
